extends.relationship: Additive extension. Reuses the v1 episode reconstruction, canonical MFE/MAE reconciliation and the frozen 71-cell grid unchanged; adds only fields v1 did not compute. v1 outputs and conclusions are not modified.

frozen_window.rule: The source protocol window must equal this window, no bar at or after end_exclusive may be present, and an explicit as_of later than latest_permitted_as_of is rejected.

episode_fields.bars_to_mfe: bar offset from entry bar (0-based) of the first bar attaining the episode MFE; null when MFE is 0
episode_fields.bars_to_mae: bar offset from entry bar (0-based) of the first bar attaining the episode MAE; null when MAE is 0
episode_fields.excursion_order: MFE_FIRST | MAE_FIRST | SAME_BAR | NO_MFE | NO_MAE | NONE. SAME_BAR means the extremes share an OHLC bar and their order is unobservable; it is never resolved by assumption.
episode_fields.static_gross_bps: side * (exit_open / entry_open - 1) * 1e4; same fixed-entry-price convention as MFE/MAE
episode_fields.path_gross_bps: product over held bars of (1 + side * open-to-open return) - 1, in bps; must reconcile with the canonical ledger gross_bps
episode_fields.short_rebalance_gap_bps: ledger gross minus static gross; identically 0 for +/-1 longs, non-zero for shorts because the canonical ledger compounds a per-bar rebalanced short
episode_fields.capture_ratio: static_gross_bps / mfe_bps when mfe_bps > 0, else null; not clipped

cell_statistics.effective_n_sufficiency: Post-first-run conservative amendment (2026-09-26): each cell also reports effective_n_sufficiency, SUFFICIENT only when effective_n >= minimum_sufficient_trades. It can only downgrade a cell, never select one. Added because the first run showed effective N of about 16-31 even for cells with thousands of trades.
cell_statistics.top_decile_profit_share: sum of net_bps over the top ceil(10%) trades by net_bps, counting only positive values, divided by the sum of all positive net_bps; null when no positive trade
cell_statistics.skewness: adjusted Fisher-Pearson sample skewness of net_bps; null when n < 3 or zero variance
cell_statistics.effective_n: Kish cluster effective size n^2 / sum_b n_b^2 over 30-day calendar blocks of entry time
cell_statistics.win_rate_vs_payoff_comparison: each cell reports its delta versus the same strategy x direction ALL cell for win_rate, expectancy_bps, median and p90 mfe_bps, and p10/p50/p90 net_bps
cell_statistics.ranking: none; cells are emitted in fixed predeclared order and no ordering, selection or best-cell field is produced

bootstrap.unit: UTC calendar day of trade entry, from the first entry day to the last entry day inclusive, including days with no entries
bootstrap.note: Intervals are descriptive uncertainty only; no p-values or hypothesis tests are produced.
